test_objective: If a Subscription does not define a timeInterval member, the notification shall be sent whenever there is a change in the watched Attributes. The notification message shall include all the subscribed Entities that changed and that match (as mandated by clauses 4.9 and 4.10) the query and geoquery conditions

test_cases.name: 046_05_01 Check that a notification is sent with all entities
test_cases.doc: The notification message shall include all the subscribed Entities that changed and that match (as mandated by clauses 4.9 and 4.10) the query and geoquery conditions
test_cases.then:
then {
    the client at '${endpoint}' receives a valid Notification containing:
        After waiting '5' seconds and
        Notification data: '${notification}[subscriptionId]' equal to '${subscription_id}' and
        Notification data: '${notification}[data][0][id]' equal to '${entity_id}' and
        Notification data: '${notification}[data][0][name][value]' equal to 'Eiffel Tower' and
        The dictionary `${notification}' should contain the key 'data' and
        The variable `${notification}[data]' should not be '${EMPTY}' and
        The expression `'${notification}[data][0][airQualityLevel][value]'=='5.0' or '${notification}[data][0][airQualityLevel][value]'=='5'' should be True
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}/attrs'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'airQualityLevel-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
